messages:
Erin (AE): FYI Newbridge wants to move from EdgeModel -> Redwood. They asked for a compatibility pathway (drop-in), prompt parity for ~150 canonical flows, and answers to a security checklist. They want a short POC next week. Maya from Newbridge on-thread.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Hey team 0110
(Just kidding) Main points: ~2.5M tokens/month, heavy use of embeddings+rerank, and a lot of client-side prompt pre/post-processing built around EdgeModel's /v2/generate shape. They rely on a metadata "trace" field in every response and deterministic stop-sequence handling (EdgeModel truncates at token boundary differently). Need to know if Redwood can emit an identical envelope or whether we'll map fields. Also need retention policy 12mo and KMS integration.

Jorge (SE): We can ship a lightweight compat proxy that accepts EdgeModel-style requests and forwards to Redwood, transforming responses. Two options: (1) Proxy container (Go) that rewrites JSON, headers, and error codes; (2) Node adapter for their infra. For parity tests I need: sample requests, EdgeModel responses, and their 150 canonical prompts. I'll run our parity harness `bin/parity_check` which outputs per-prompt diff + per-token mismatch.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Uploading a gz of prompts+responses to share drive now. Will include 5 failure cases (rate-limit 429, 500 server error, 413 payload too large, 401 invalid key, and slow 5s responses).

Nina (Security): I'll take the sec checklist. Quick answers: SOC2 report available on NDA. KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private and Dedicated; hosted option uses Redwood-managed KMS. We also support SAML SSO and OIDC. Please confirm whether they require HSM-backed encryption or SSE-C. If they need HSM + dedicated audit retention 12mo we should recommend Dedicated or Private.

Ravi (CSM): Pricing note: ballpark hosted run-rate @ 2.5M tokens = ~$2k/mo at public hosted tiers. Dedicated pricing will depend on committed throughput and model choice; I'll draft a 12-month committed quote once Jorge confirms model/throughput. Also flagging their latency SLO: p95 <250ms for chat.

Jorge (SE): For p95 <250ms under spikes we recommend Dedicated with prefix KV caching + small batch windows. Example POC config we usually propose: `{"model":"redwood-3b-opt","routing":"latency","batching":{"max_batch_size":6},"cache":{"prefix_kv":true}}`. I'll run a load test after parity shim is live.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): One more: EdgeModel includes `id` and `epoch` fields in response; can Redwood preserve those? If not, we need a deterministic mapping so our clients don't break.

Jorge (SE): We can preserve `id` by echoing EdgeModel's id into `metadata.client_id` or keep the top-level `id` if they prefer exact shape. The proxy will allow exact passthrough for fields.

Erin (AE): Action items: Maya uploads samples (Maya), Jorge builds proxy + runs parity checks (Jorge), Nina completes sec answers (Nina), Ravi drafts committed quote (Ravi). I'll send NDA/MSA template so SOC2 can be shared.

DeployBot: Created POC workspace: s3://redwood-pocs/newbridge-1830000123 (30d retention).

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Samples uploaded: link posted. Will ping once questionnaire completed. Also wondering about error code parity: EdgeModel returns 422 for prompt-too-long. Can you map that?

Jorge (SE): Yes, the shim can map Redwood 413 -> 422 for parity. Parity harness will flag semantic differences (stop-token truncation, whitespace handling). Preliminary ETA: 72h for initial parity report after I get samples.

Nina (Security): Quick Q: Do we need to involve legal for cross-border log retention? Newbridge will store logs in EU-only region. We can support regional tenancy on Private/Dedicated; hosted also supports eu-west-1.

Ravi (CSM): I'll prepare hosted vs committed cost comparison and include latency guarantees. If parity passes we'll fast-track Dedicated proposal.

Erin (AE): Thanks all. I'll set a follow-up on calendar for Friday to review parity results and the security checklist.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Appreciate it 44D

Jorge (SE): :thumbsup: will post the diff summary into this thread.

Erin (AE): Closing loop 4CB - updating the deal in CRM with tasks and owners.
